title: The prism espresso machine
alt: An espresso machine combines brushed steel, green stone and brass around a cup on its drip tray.
description: Coherent appliance connections, reflective materials and restrained product styling in one complete photograph.
prompt: A complete sculptural espresso machine made of brushed stainless steel, smoked glass and a single emerald-green stone panel. A clearly attached portafilter projects from the central brew head above a ceramic cup standing on a perforated drip tray; a separate steam wand curves down on the right. Brass control knobs and a visible glass water reservoir add functional detail. A matching empty saucer sits beside the machine. Refined industrial design photography, coherent construction, muted stone backdrop, no lettering.
